summary_1line: Surya explains a Brahmana ascetic who, through the Unccha vow and austerity, attained heaven and dwells in the solar disc; another Brahmana resolves to follow the vow.

image_candidates.scene_text: A radiant ascetic merges indistinguishably with the blazing disc of Surya as celestial beings watch in confusion.
A Brahmana sage and a great Naga converse beneath the shade of a forest tree about the path of righteousness.
